extz.py.summary: Report the file extensions used below the current directory.
details: Counts the files per extension with their sizes, prints a coloured table of the most common ones, and ``-s`` switches to the total size per extension while ``-p`` writes a Matplotlib pie chart (the top 30 are charted).

exurls.py.summary: Extract the links of a web page and save them to files.
details: Fetches the URL with a browser-like session, parses the ``href``/``src`` attributes with BeautifulSoup, splits the internal and the external links and writes both lists to the current directory.

fa_translator.py.summary: Persian to English (and back) translation toolkit.
details: Subcommands: ``file`` translates a text file line by line or in chunks, ``words`` builds a JSON dictionary from a word list and ``lookup`` is an offline dictionary search with optional fzf selection. The backends are deep_translator, the ``translate`` package and the ``translate`` CLI.

faedit.py.summary: Edit Persian text with a live ``faprint`` preview.
details: Opens the file in urwid, curses, prompt_toolkit or textual (``-b``), shows the reshaped Persian rendering of the lines around the cursor and saves and quits with Ctrl+Q.

failtest.py.summary: Run a program repeatedly until it fails.
details: Executes the command in a loop (optionally ``-p`` in parallel), stops at the first exit status outside the accepted codes, sleeps between the iterations and reports the failing output.

fast_compress.py.summary: Compress or decompress the files of a directory with zstd or xz.
details: The ``zstd`` subcommand compresses with 4 threads at level 3 (``--level`` 1-22) and the ``xz`` one through ``lzma_mt``; both work in a process pool, skip the excluded and package directories, keep the originals with ``--keep`` and ``--simple`` switches to a plain recursive glob.

fatrans.py.summary: Translate files to and from Farsi.
details: Subcommands: ``to-fa`` translates a file into Persian, ``lines-to-en`` translates the Farsi lines of one file, ``inplace-to-en`` walks a tree and rewrites the Farsi files in English and ``batch-json`` writes one JSON map per ``.txt`` file. The chunks are retried and slept between the requests.

fatranslate.py.summary: Translate Persian lines and word lists to English.
details: The ``lines`` subcommand translates the Persian lines of a file (updating the file in place unless ``--no-update``) and writes a JSON dictionary, ``words`` does the same for a word list; the chunks are retried, the parallelism is a process pool and the log level is configurable.

fco.py.summary: Convert fonts between TTF, OTF, WOFF and WOFF2.
details: Detects the input format (Type 1 ``pfa``/``pfb`` are converted to a CFF-outlined OTF), writes the requested ``--to`` format next to the source (or under ``-o``), and offers ``-r`` to drop the original, ``-f`` to overwrite and ``--dry-run``; the files are processed in parallel.

felopy.py.summary: Run the ``felo superagent`` query and save the returned code as a Python file.
details: Calls the external ``felo`` command with the query and the timeout, extracts the fenced Python blocks of the output and writes them to ``~/tmp/apps/felo_<timestamp>.py``, printing the path.

felormc.py.summary: Strip the comments and docstrings of Python files with LibCST.
details: Keeps the shebangs, the module docstrings and the pragma comments (``# type:``, ``# fmt:``, ``# noqa``), validates every result before writing and offers ``--dry-run``, ``--verbose`` and a spawn-based pool over the given paths or the current tree.

fetchimages.py.summary: Crawl a website and download its images.
details: Breadth-first crawls the pages of the same host (``--all-hosts`` opens it up), bounded by ``--max-pages`` and ``--max-depth``, and saves every image into ``downloads`` (``-o``) under a sanitised name with dedup by content hash.
